name: clipsai-root
description: Orquestación unificada ClipsAI — 5 servicios (db, 2 backends, 2 frontends) + ngrok

scripts.dev:full: docker compose up -d --build && npm run dev
scripts.dev:up: docker compose up -d db backend_fastapi backend_express
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend_react install && npm --prefix frontend_vue install && npm --prefix backend_express install
